authorization.scope: Publish the 354 evidence.tar.gz grading archives under bench/regrading/rule-v4-regrade-2026-10-25*/ that no earlier manifest lists (350 saved grades and 4 failed attempts) to the public release evidence-rule-v4-regrade-2026-10-25-v1 of kamui/code-review-bench, packaged without recompressing or editing the archives' bytes, after the credential, identity and network reviews in release-draft/README.md. This approval covers this one release only. The 17 failed attempts that were never archived are not covered.

selection.subject_form: bench/regrading/rule-v4-regrade-2026-10-25*/<run>/<target>/attempt-<N>, every archived attempt that no earlier manifest lists: 350 saved grades and 4 failed attempts
selection.path_rule: Each archive's portable path is its repository path, the path its committed evidence.json pins. Every archive's SHA-256 equalled its evidence.json hash before packing, and every package member keeps that hash.

credential_review.reviewed: 2026-10-30, before the release was created, on every member of every archive; a second run gave the same counts
credential_review.result: No credential file and no credential. Token-shaped matches are public pull-request image links, source and documentation examples, test strings, a documentation placeholder and encrypted model reasoning.

identity_review.account_email: Absent: neither the owner's email address nor the git author address occurs in any member.
identity_review.account_and_user_id: One user ID and one account ID, the same as in the published rule-version-3 grading archives, compared by hash; two plan types in the rate-limit records.
identity_review.other: The Windows login name in skill folder paths, the skill names, local home paths, and six upstream maintainers' addresses from public project files, as release-draft/README.md lists.

network_review.result: Every tool call in the session transcripts is one of the six grading tools; no web search, no shell, no external host.

exclusions: The 17 failed attempts that were never archived (their receipts and sessions stay in the regrade checkouts' .local/ folders); the approval does not cover them.
The committed evidence.json records, which stay in Git and pin each archive's hash.
limitations: The local source files stay on this machine, ignored by Git at their repository paths.
The four failed attempts' charges are unknown upper bounds, as their receipts record.

publication.cold_fetch: bench-tools evidence fetch of the whole manifest into an empty root restored all 354 files; each matched the local archive's SHA-256.
